intro: Practical guides on AI workout plans, hybrid training, and recovery — written to be useful whether or not you ever use Kiron.

posts.title: How to Turn a ChatGPT Workout Plan Into a Program You Can Actually Track
posts.excerpt: ChatGPT writes surprisingly good workout plans — and then leaves you with a wall of text. Here's how to prompt for a better plan, sanity-check it before you trust it, and four honest ways to track it (only one of which is ours).

posts.title: Running and Lifting in the Same Week: A Schedule That Actually Works
posts.excerpt: The three spacing rules that stop your squats and your intervals from wrecking each other, three weekly templates to steal, and how to keep a hybrid week in one place.

posts.title: How Long Should Muscles Recover Between Workouts? A Guide by Muscle Group
posts.excerpt: Realistic recovery windows by muscle group, why soreness is a bad readiness signal, the signs you're training a muscle too soon — and how to plan your split around all of it.

posts.title: How to Follow a Multi-Phase Training Plan (Base, Build, Peak) Without a Coach
posts.excerpt: Phased plans fail at the seams — the transitions, not the workouts. What each phase is for, why self-coached athletes drift off schedule, and three ways to keep a 16-week plan on track.

posts.title: Workout Spreadsheet vs. App: An Honest Comparison From People Who Sell the App
posts.excerpt: Spreadsheets are free, flexible, and have powered decades of PRs — sometimes they're genuinely the better tool. When each one wins, and the three signs it's time to switch.
